newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 28.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on February 28. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The House of Representatives have approved the 1997/98 draft budget. President Suharto presented the country's 1997/98 budget draft in January with revenue expected to reach 101.1 trillion rupiah.
Two senior government officials said that Indonesia's six million civil servants had to vote for the ruling Golkar party in the May 29 general elections.
State-owned oil and gas company Pertamina is offering 27 areas for oil and gas exploration this year, including 15 in eastern Indonesia.
Indonesia has agreed to export coal to Croatia through counter trade. Croatian Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa is in Indonesia for an official visit.
A government study has predicted the population of East Timor will reach one million by the year 2002, up from the present 900,000.
